name: @wcdraft/db
description: Server-only database layer for wcdraft (Drizzle ORM over Neon Postgres). F-1 RED — greenfield schema + migrations only; no route-handler wiring (F-2/F-3/F-4) and no replacement of the legacy LeaderboardSubmissionSchema (F-4). Anonymous-first, cost-firewalled: no per-game DB access; auth/session, saved-run R/W, and leaderboard re-sim are the only consumers.
